title: Box‑Sizing Bug Fix
description: Diagnose and fix a broken layout caused by content‑box sizing, then apply the universal reset.
hints: The total width per column = 50% of 600px = 300px content, plus padding and border → 300 + 20 + 2 = 322px each. Two columns = 644px > 600px, so they wrap.
By setting `box-sizing: border-box;`, the 50% width includes padding and border, so each column stays at 300px total.
expectedOutput: Comments explaining the issue, then corrected CSS using border-box.
